case: CSV and XLSX output for a compound STRICT ANY result
contract: A native SQLite UNION ALL result with INTEGER, TEXT and SQL NULL reaches the core result-file exporters with conservative expression metadata.
CSV emits the exact row text and storage-class diagnostic values.
The real XLSX workbook stores the integer result as a numeric cell, the text result as a shared-string cell, and SQL NULL as an absent cell.
This verifies XLSX cell representation for the compound result; it does not claim spreadsheet-application import or CSV storage-class restoration.

app_sqlite_any_contracts.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app sqlite_any_contract:: -- --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Typed CSV round-trip of compound SQLite runtime storage classes remains unproven.
Other consumers and spreadsheet-application re-import remain open; this case does not close the broader B3 matrix.
